**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that mutations in CLCNKB and SCNN1A do not functionally impair the renal salt reabsorption pathway, or that the resulting molecular defects do not converge on the same downstream physiological consequences leading to the observed overlapping phenotypes. _(variant: High frequency of pathogenic variants for CLCNKB or SCNN1A in gnomAD, suggesting a common genetic etiology rather than rare disease.)_
